posts.point: Gentle everyday washing

image.headline:
Everyday washing,
done gently.

posts.instagram:
A simple routine for keeping things fresh and comfortable:

▷ Use warm water, not hot.
▷ A small amount of mild, unscented soap is enough.
▷ Rinse well so no soap is left behind.
▷ Pat dry with a clean towel before dressing.

If you notice pain, swelling or anything unusual, see a doctor.

This is general hygiene information, not medical advice.

Not a medical device. 18+.

image.headline:
Looking after
your Luca Bloom.

posts.instagram:
A few habits keep your tool clean and in good shape:

▷ Wash with mild detergent and water before and after every use, including the screw thread.
▷ Dry it thoroughly. You can disinfect it with alcohol.
▷ Never boil it or use hot water; heat can deform it.
▷ Check the arms for cracks before each use.
▷ Store at room temperature, out of direct sunlight and away from children.
